svg.title: WASTE ROOM: CONTAINERS, AISLE, DRAG ROUTE
svg.text: STANDARDS SHEET 07 · SHARED AMENITY · WASTE
WASTE ROOM:
CONTAINERS, AISLE, DRAG ROUTE
SOURCES
strength · confidence (see data/catalogue/README.md)
[PROGRAMME · sourced]
Avfall Sverige, PM 'Uppdatering av dimensionering för avfallsutrymmen' (Ramboll, Sept 2023) tabell 15-16 pp. 31-32 and collection frequencies
p. 30; the same values, container footprints and the 1.5 m aisle are reproduced from Avfall Sveriges Handbok för avfallsutrymmen in Sysav
'Handbok för avfallshantering' (2025) printed pp. 14-18. Municipalities adopt or adjust these in their avfallsföreskrifter; BFS 2024:8 sets no
weekly volumes, container footprints, 1.5 m aisle — https://www.avfallsverige.se/media/awdltdok/pm-uppdatering-av-dimensionering-av-avfallsutrymmen.pdf
[PROGRAMME · sourced]
Sysav, 'Handbok för avfallshantering' (2025) printed pp. 12-13, 18 (after Avfall Sveriges Handbok för avfallsutrymmen)
drag route ≤ 10 m, 1.2 / 1.35 m wide, 2.1 m high, ≤ 1:12 — https://www.sysav.se/media/y2fnidqi/handbok-för-avfallshantering_2025_web.pdf
[LAW · —]
BFS 2024:8 11 kap. 1 §: waste must be manageable in or next to the building, and there must be avfallsanordningar or avfallsutrymmen (not for one- and
two-dwelling houses, and not where unnecessary given the use). 2 §: placed, designed and dimensioned to limit risks to users' and neighbours' hygiene and
health. 3 §: so that the waste can be handled and removed in the way required; dwellings must have space for temporary storage of waste. Sorting duties:
everyone with waste must sort out the listed waste types (Avfallsförordningen 3 kap. 2 §), bioavfall including biodegradable food and kitchen waste (3 kap.
7 §) and packaging by material (3 kap. 8 §); businesses must sort further types (3 kap. 2 a §) and deliver business packaging themselves (3 kap. 11 §). The
municipality must collect food or kitchen waste, packaging waste and residual waste fastighetsnära, from one and the same place; for flerbostadshus the
municipality and owner may agree on different places (3 kap. 36 §), with exceptions in 37 §.
waste room required, sized to limit risks — https://rinfo.boverket.se/BFS2024-8/pdf/BFS2024-8.pdf
[LAW · —]
Avfallsförordning (2020:614) 3 kap. 2, 2 a, 7, 8, 11, 36, 37 §§
sorting and collection duties — https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/avfallsforordning-2020614_sfs-2020-614/
Data: data/catalogue/uses/shared_amenities.json → spaces / shared_waste_room (size.count, mixing_constraints). Drawn 2026-10-20 by docs/draw_standards_sheets.py. Diagrammatic, not to scale;
figures and furniture without a dimension are illustrative only. No values are taken from Neufert (catalogue policy: page references only).
